title: Articulation study of one armour part
description: The user's gauntlet hand study: a fixed close camera, the part named with its anatomy, references described by side, a beats schedule, plates sliding at real joints.

body.subject: ONE anatomical {{side}} {{part}} exactly as in [start_image], {{design_lock}}.
body.action: The part articulates through the schedule below: rigid plates slide and rotate at real joints without changing shape.
body.camera: Fixed close camera, no movement, no zoom, no cuts.
body.style: Flat even studio light, plain neutral backdrop.
body.constraints: The end pose equals the start pose; exactly one {{part}}, no extra fingers or plates, same design throughout.

design_lock.default: every plate, rivet and gold trim unchanged

start_image.description: the part in the start pose

bytedance/seedance*.note: names references in prose; roles are start_image / end_image / video references

higgsfield/*.note: Higgsfield media roles: start_image, end_image, image_references, video_references

heygen/*.note: audio is always on and not controllable; only a first frame is taken
